title: Bubble Sort
description: Write a Zig program that implements bubble sort to sort an array of integers in ascending order.
verificationTest: output.includes('11') && output.includes('22') && output.includes('25') && output.includes('34') && output.includes('64') && output.includes('90')
hints: Bubble sort repeatedly steps through the list, swapping adjacent elements if they're in the wrong order
Track whether any swaps occurred each pass with a `swapped` flag
If no swaps occurred, the array is sorted and you can break early
